none: PAS CAM-CBA493: Roman Coin : A, Possibly Pierced, Incomplete Silver-Plated Copper-alloy Core of a Contemporary Copy of a Denarius of Caracalla, AD196-217
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A, possibly pierced, incomplete silver-plated copper-alloy core of a contemporary copy of a denarius of Caracalla, AD196-217 (with a reverse of Septimius Severus), dating to c. AD 201-210 (Reece period 10). Probably based on coins from the mint of Rome. Obverse legend reads [ANTO]NINVS PIVS AVG. Obverse shows Laureate head right. Reverse legend reads [...]S[...]. Reverse shows Victory flying left…
